queries.Path selection: To address the training-: Path selection inference for BERT-family text generation that samples multiple candidate decoding paths for re-masked tokens and selects the path with highest total prediction probability using limited k candidates to address training-inference decomposition mismatch
queries.Path selection*: To enable BERT-family m: Training BERT-family masked language models to prefer specific decoding paths using Direct Preference Optimization, where two sampled decoding paths for masked tokens generate outputs scored by exact match, BLEU metrics to form positive-negative pairs, then optimizing a modified DPO loss with penalty terms, masked language modeling loss, freezing a reference model, updating a policy model.
queries.GeBERT: To support fair evaluation of BE: GeBERT BERT-family generative masked language model with modified masking, rotary positional embeddings, SwiGLU activations, and fair evaluation of generation performance versus autoregressive models
queries.Pre-training GeBERT with generative mask: Pre-training Generative BERT models on Pile with masked language modeling that decomposes instances into prefix and suffix parts with different masking ratios to address training-inference decomposition mismatch
queries.Zero-shot evaluation: To assess the gene: Zero-shot evaluation of a generative BERT-family model on common sense reasoning and reading comprehension benchmarks such as ARC, BoolQ, PIQA, SIQA, WinoGrande, Race, SciQ, LogiQA, HellaSwag, and TruthfulQA using a language model evaluation framework, compared with autoregressive baselines including OPT, GPT-neo, Pythia, and RWKV at similar parameter scales.
queries.Task-specific generation evaluation: To: Task-specific fine-tuning evaluation of BERT-family generative models on XSUM summarization and MSQG question generation, comparing autoregressive and non-autoregressive baselines using ROUGE F1, BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and generation speed.
queries.Ablation studies: To isolate the contrib: Ablation studies for BERT-family text generation path selection inference and DPO-like training, comparing decoding path selection methods, token-aware beam search, and hyperparameter effects on masked language model generation
